name: Branched Gill
flavor: Feathered respiratory surface for steadier output.

name: Compound Eye
flavor: Hundreds of lenses resolving the murk.

name: Sclerite Mineralization
flavor: The trick of pulling calcite out of seawater and wearing it.

name: Gnathobase
flavor: Crushing tooth-plates at the base of the legs.

name: Nematocyst Battery
flavor: Stinging cells you can fire on contact.

name: Raptorial Appendage
flavor: A grasping limb built for ambush.

name: Great Appendage
flavor: The launch meta's apex weapon: a grasping arm nothing in the shallows out-reaches.

name: Notochord
flavor: A stiff internal rod — the earliest version of a spine. Haikouichthys ran this build on day one.

name: Filter Combs
flavor: Tamisiocaris's frontal appendages repurposed as plankton sieves. Pure uptime in open water.

name: Eversible Proboscis
flavor: Ottoia's throat can turn itself inside out to grab. The Devs did not intend for this to be harvested.

name: Spine Rows
flavor: Wiwaxia's sclerite fence, repurposed as a danger-tax guard.

name: Glassy Tissue
flavor: Near-total transparency in open water — the stealth roll that costs nothing but density.

name: Ambush Instinct
flavor: The reef lurker's stillness is not patience — it is calculated exploitation of the ambush window.
